cards.title: A story got better and the trade got worse in the same hour: Iran, Hormuz and oil
cards.why: Two independent outlets put Iran's foreign minister on the record with a seven-day plan, and oil went from -2.57% to -2.00% on the upgrade, because a named source also names the obstacle. Fully sourced, and a clean lesson in reading a headline against a price.

cards.title: Nine percent on a press statement: what a company has actually filed versus what it has told reporters
cards.why: Bloom is up 8.92% on a reaffirmation that appears nowhere in either company's SEC filings, proven this run from the regulator's own index. That gap between a quote and a disclosure is a durable teaching point, not a one-day story.
